summary: Run the setup module ad hoc (ansible -m setup hostname) to list all facts for a host; this excludes inventory variables and magic variables.
questions: How do I list all facts Ansible gathers for a host?
Does ansible -m setup show inventory variables?

answer_card.title: List all facts for a host
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
ansible -m setup hostname | less
```

Shows all gathered **facts**, but not inventory variables or magic variables. Use `-a 'filter=ansible_distribution*'` to narrow it.
